title: Reproducibility package for Quantum Data Encoding Trade-offs in Parallel Hybrid Image Classification
description: Versioned code and processed-result package supporting the manuscript Quantum Data Encoding Trade-offs in Parallel Hybrid Image Classification. The repository provides standardized training and evaluation entry points for Amplitude, Angle, IQP-All, IQP-NN, and Basis-STE pipelines; classical bottleneck controls; processed publication records; principal figures; circuit-resource analysis; and the deterministic MNIST/Fashion-MNIST split protocol. The evidence is limited to the documented four-branch CNN-PQC scaffold and does not establish quantum advantage, hardware robustness, a universal encoding ranking, or a causal effect attributable to the straight-through estimator alone. Raw datasets and unverified legacy checkpoints are not redistributed.
